Issue #5 (https://github.com/takahirox/gitweave-test/issues/5) is closed. GitHub closed it on its own at 2026-09-25T02:38:07Z, one second after PR #6 was merged, because of the PR's "Closes #5" line. GitHub marks the issue as completed and shows PR #6 as the pull request that closed it.

I checked that PR #6 is merged with merge commit `60be361a075c518519a20235d3ee98d583e816c8`. The issue was already closed and linked to PR #6, so I didn't change anything on GitHub or in the worktree.
